title: I'm giving these a 1 star just because of the design
text: I'm giving these a 1 star just because of the design. honestly I'm not impressed with this bathroom set at all with the sole exception that I like the design on them.  The rugs are ok, but they show feet imprints and hold water long after showering, the toilet cover is nothing more than a rug with 2 straps across it and the toilet rug is ok but with the other two items being so cheap looking it detracts from any appeal it might have had.  The shower curtain I do like though so it will be the one piece from this set I'll be keeping.
